summary: Owner amendment A0019, layer CONTRACT, applies the recorded Owner direction to exactly the eight named PLANNED tasks - T071, T072, T082, T085, T086, T091, T103 and T104 - and closes the eight remaining A0013 contract findings on paper authorization, the versioned write path, owner journeys, caller classes and page ownership. T071 and T072 state the G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 prerequisite (the active-PoolKey selection, both tokens' HOLD/LP approvals and the preliminary-paper authorization, completed by the Owner through the Web entry point T073 delivers) and gate the paper run and the decision resume on it, with T073 added to their dependencies; T082 states the same prerequisite for its soak window, refuses to count a window with an absent, superseded or mismatched authorization as SLO evidence, and depends on T073. T085 declares that it extends the versioned write path T073 delivered rather than creating a second mechanism, and narrows its CLI prohibition to match CTRL-CLI-001 exactly: CLI writes may only reduce risk, an increase fails closed and points at the Web write entry, and a reduce-only CLI write is neither refused wholesale nor routed through an increase-risk approval. T086 extends its owner journeys and its accessibility, viewport and Web security scope to the two console pages WEB-PAGE-012 and WEB-PAGE-013 and depends on T087 and T088. T091 declares the second intent class - the CLI reduce, collect and exit intents T097 sends, planned through the same pre-execution checks without a strategy approval - while every risk increase still goes through the Web write entry. T103 states that its results view is not the specification's backtest result page, which T088 owns with WEB-PAGE-013, and that any training or evaluation trigger it offers carries T069 run identity and lifecycle semantics instead of implying a second run surface. T104 acknowledges the second console consumer, the T088 backtest result page, and requires every range or liquidity value rendered from its surface to declare the window, dataset version and reconstruction revision it came from. Resolved: A0013:T071:legacy, A0013:T072:legacy, A0013:T082:legacy, A0013:T085:legacy, A0013:T086:legacy, A0013:T091:legacy, A0013:T103:legacy and A0013:T104:legacy; the four approved-predecessor impacts A0013:T063:legacy, A0013:T064:legacy, A0013:T066:legacy and A0013:T067:legacy stay open and are named in the rationale.
rationale:
OWNER DIRECTION AND BOUNDARY. The change set is exactly the eight target contracts and the depends_on lists of four of them (T071, T072, T082, T086) in todo/config.yaml, which is what the allowed-path loop at tools/workflow/core.py:1699-1716 permits a CONTRACT amendment to touch; the config drift rule (_without_amendment_owned_config_fields, tools/workflow/core.py:470-483) pops depends_on for the targets, and a field-for-field comparison of the base and candidate configs shows the only changed task fields are those four lists. No status, attempt, base/candidate/approved commit, latest_review, superseded_by, task set, active_phase, active_task, workflow_state, intent_revision or spec_revision moved; the eight targets stay PLANNED at attempt 0; no path under src/, tests/, tools/, docs/, .github/, .claude/ or todo/schemas/ changed. Nothing outside the direction was introduced: every added sentence traces to a clause of the recorded direction or to the A0013 finding it closes.

T071 AND T072 (close A0013:T071:legacy and A0013:T072:legacy). The finding was that neither contract said anything about T073, and that Dependencies named only T061/T070 and T033/T071, so a reader saw a task that could run paper (T071) or resume decisions that drive paper (T072) as soon as its listed dependencies were approved, while the three Owner authorizations had no machine precondition. T071: dependencies become T061, T070, T073; the Outcome states the G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 prerequisite and that no paper run starts and no simulated balance changes while T073 is not APPROVED or a record is absent, superseded or not bound to the active pool and strategy version; the Deliverables add the paper-run gate; the Acceptance adds the refusal test; the Must not adds operating before T073 is APPROVED and treating a missing authorization as a warning; the References add G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01, WEB-GLOBAL-006 and T073. T072 keeps ingestion allowed to backfill, catch up and follow, and gates only the decision resume: the Outcome, a Deliverables paragraph and an Acceptance clause require the three records before decisions resume, and the Must not forbids resuming them while a G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 authorization is absent, superseded or bound to a different pool or strategy version.

T082 (closes A0013:T082:legacy). The finding was that a sustained soak window could run and be recorded as SLO evidence with T073 absent from its 37-task closure. The contract now depends on T072, T073, T080 and T081 (closure 49), states that the window runs on an authorized paper configuration, records the three authorizations it ran under, starts only after T073 is APPROVED and the records exist, reports a window that began without them or ran while one was superseded or mismatched as invalid evidence naming the affected interval, and forbids counting such a window as SLO evidence. T082 is the shadow/soak task, not the live-qualification task, so nothing here weakens or advances the promotion gates.

T085 (closes A0013:T085:legacy, which carried two stale statements). First: nothing obliged T085 to continue T073's versioned write path although todo/README.md section 6 and WEB-GLOBAL-006 (docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md:58, the 'same semantics continue through its versioned write path, not a second mechanism' sentence at :66-67) require it. A new section, 'The versioned write path this task extends', states that one store, one version sequence and one audit history carry the drafts, impact previews, reauthentications, confirmations, immutable versions and audit events of both, and that the objects T073 already versions - the active PoolKey selection, the tokens' HOLD/LP permissions and exposure limits, and the preliminary-paper authorization - are the same records this task continues to version rather than a parallel copy; a second store for an already-versioned object is named a defect. Second: the Must-not clause 'let CLI bypass approval' read literally forbids exactly the reduce-only CLI write G-PERM-WRITE-01 (docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md:535) and CTRL-CLI-001 (docs/spec/operations/OPERATOR_CONTROL.md:187, its reduce-only write set at :192-197) order the CLI to perform. It is narrowed in place to 'let the CLI bypass Web approval for an increase, refuse a reduce-only CLI write that CTRL-CLI-001 requires to succeed or route it through an increase-risk approval', and the new section states the matching positive rule: CLI writes may only reduce risk, an increase fails closed with no version and no action and points at the Web write entry under WEB-GLOBAL-003, and a reduction is neither refused wholesale nor routed through an increase-risk approval. No dependency edge was added for T085, because the direction did not ask for one and the measured path T085 -> T084 -> T072 -> T073 already carries T073 into its closure (44 to 50 tasks), so the extension obligation has a machine-visible producer without a duplicate edge.

T086 (closes A0013:T086:legacy). The finding was that the complete owner journeys excluded WEB-PAGE-012 and WEB-PAGE-013 and the contract depended only on T083/T085. The Deliverables now add registry and run journeys over both pages (choosing a registered strategy with a schema-declared parameter and a covered range, triggering, observing and cancelling a run on WEB-PAGE-012, and reading a completed run's result, its coverage gaps and its unexplained residual on WEB-PAGE-013); the accessibility, viewport and Web security report is extended to cover every console page including those two; the Acceptance adds the two journeys on a clean profile and the widened report; the References name both pages and note that T103's four research pages keep carrying their own journeys. Dependencies become T083, T085, T087 and T088 (closure 50 to 56, now containing T087, T088, T069 and T073).

T091 (closes A0013:T091:legacy). The finding was that the declared input was a single intent class while T097 makes CLI-issued reduce, collect and exit intents a second caller class the same pre-execution checks must plan. The Outcome now declares that the planner accepts more than one intent class, names the CLI's reduce or remove LP, collect and exit intents as planned through the same pre-execution checks without a strategy approval because they only lower a permission or an exposure, and states that every increase goes through the Web write entry (WEB-GLOBAL-003, G-PERM-WRITE-01), the only increase path; the Deliverables and the Acceptance carry the same for both caller classes, including refusal before planning of a CLI-issued increase with the pointer recorded; the Must not adds requiring a strategy approval for a risk-reducing CLI intent and planning a CLI-originated increase; the frozen References placeholder is replaced with OPERATOR_CONTROL.md (CTRL-CLI-001), PROJECT_GOALS.md (G-PERM-WRITE-01, G-EXEC-01), WEB_CONSOLE.md (WEB-GLOBAL-003), T070, T071, T072, T090 and T097. No dependency edge to T097 was added and none may be: a DFS colour check on the configured graph shows T091 -> T097 -> T091 is a cycle, so T097 stays the caller, which is what the contract now says.

T103 (closes A0013:T103:legacy). The finding was that the unnamed results view was confusable with the page the specification names as the backtest result and assigns to T088, and that a training or evaluation trigger implied a second run surface without T069's identity and lifecycle. The results-view deliverable is now named as belonging to WEB-PAGE-011 and explicitly not WEB-PAGE-013, with the Ownership of that other surface attributed to T088; a new deliverable requires every training or evaluation trigger to submit through the T069 run entry point and carry its identity, queued/running-with-progress, failed, cancelled and succeeded states, reason codes and no complete-looking artifact after a cancellation or failure, with the page displaying the reported state instead of restating it; the Acceptance adds both, and the References name T069 (reached transitively through T101 and T102) and T088. No dependency edge was added: the measured path T103 -> T102 -> T101 -> T069 already carries T069 into the closure (53 to 57 tasks), and T088 owns a different surface rather than being a producer T103 consumes.

T104 (closes A0013:T104:legacy). The finding was that the contract attributed the console range view to a single task while the amendment adds a second range and liquidity view whose fee provenance is unstated, so a page could show a precise-looking range fee without saying which window, dataset version and reconstruction revision it came from. The Deliverables now acknowledge the second console consumer (the WEB-PAGE-013 backtest result page T088 owns) and require every range or liquidity value rendered from this surface - a range's historical fee, or a fee read at a chosen liquidity - to declare the window, the dataset version and the reconstruction revision it came from, exactly as this surface's own artifact does, with the T103 range view held to the same rule; the Acceptance adds the display-or-refuse test; the Must not adds publishing or serving a value without that provenance; the References name T088, WEB-PAGE-013, WEB-GLOBAL-002 and G-BACKTEST-RESULT-01. The requirement is stated on the surface that owns the values and on its consumers; T088 is deliberately not a target of this amendment (the direction names eight tasks and does not include it) and its contract is not left stale, because its own traceability clause already requires every value it renders to resolve to the manifest, coverage or decision record it came from and nothing in it contradicts this statement. No dependency edge was added: T104's closure is unchanged at 22 tasks and the acknowledgement is a reference, the same treatment T088 already gives T103 (todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T088.md:93-94).

PRESERVATION. Clause by clause, every original Outcome, Deliverables sentence, Acceptance criterion and Must-not prohibition is kept, and the edits are additions or in-place narrowings; each contract still carries exactly one of the six required sections; the frozen References placeholders of T082 and T091 are replaced with real citations, the same treatment A0018 gave T096; T085 gains one named section beside its existing 'Research definitions in the write path'. Nothing was dropped, weakened or duplicated, and no second authoritative path is created: T085 explicitly keeps the one versioned write path, T091 keeps the Web write entry as the only increase path, and T104 states the provenance rule its own view already had for the second view.

IMPACTS. Recomputed with the workflow's own rule (WorkflowManager._unresolved_task_impacts over todo/amendments/*/impacts.json, a resolution clearing only a strictly greater amendment ID) the register holds 12 open impacts before this amendment, all A0013 legacy ones: T063, T064, T066, T067, T071, T072, T082, T085, T086, T091, T103 and T104. This amendment resolves exactly the eight that sit on its eight targets, each of which is open and on a target task under the workflow's own check. The other four stay open and are named: A0013:T063:legacy, A0013:T064:legacy, A0013:T066:legacy and A0013:T067:legacy all sit on APPROVED contracts, which a CONTRACT amendment may not edit and which the retirement route (SUPERSEDE) must close; T096's contract already names them inside its widened closure and keeps the gate fail-closed until they are resolved.

CONSEQUENCE RECORDED. Measured from the edited files, the closures grow from 33 to 45 (T071), 34 to 46 (T072), 37 to 49 (T082), 44 to 50 (T085), 50 to 56 (T086), 35 to 47 (T091) and 53 to 57 (T103), and stay 22 for T104; the whole graph stays acyclic. T073 is now inside the closures of T071, T072, T082, T085 and T091, T087 and T088 inside T086's, and T069 inside T086's and T103's, so the prerequisite the direction calls real is enforced by the ready gate rather than only by prose. The same closure growth means T071, T072, T082, T085 and T091 now also reach the approved predecessors T063, T064 and T066 whose A0013 impacts stay open, so the ready gate will keep those tasks blocked until the retirement route closes them; that is the intended fail-closed behaviour of an open impact, not a defect this amendment introduces or hides, and T104 is unaffected. No task is activated, no attempt is consumed, and no approval, evidence, commit SHA, review record or runtime field moved.

VERIFICATION. Read-only investigation in this worktree, never task-acceptance evidence and never a substitute for the independent amendment review: python -m tools.workflow validate returns status OK; tools.check_acceptance check, tools.check_citations check and tools.check_imports check --suppressions docs/implement/ci/suppressions.toml --config todo/config.yaml --architecture docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md report no findings; PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/test_workflow.py tests/test_workflow_contracts.py tests/test_documentation_links.py tests/test_documentation_citations.py tests/test_acceptance.py is 101 passed; the wider local suite (PYTHONPATH=src pytest --ignore=tests/test_abi_artifacts.py) is 2282 passed and 6 skipped; git diff --check is clean; the contract lint was replicated directly (title, each required section exactly once, and every Dependencies line equal to its configured list, sorted and duplicate-free); the closure sizes, membership, consumer sets and the acyclicity of the graph were recomputed from the edited config, including the cycle that forbids a T091 edge to T097; and the impact register and the eight resolutions were recomputed through the workflow's own method. The contracts' own Acceptance clauses now require the tests that prove each repaired obligation, so the Developer and Reviewer of each task verify it in code.

impact_assessment.intent: No Intent edit and no intent_revision change: the config keeps v1-2026-09-20-backtest-runs-and-permission-entry. Every obligation the repaired contracts now carry already exists in docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md and was read there: G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 (:536, the active-PoolKey selection, both tokens' HOLD/LP approvals and the preliminary-paper authorization through the Web entry point before any paper run), G-PERM-WRITE-01 (:535, increases only through the Web write entry, reductions never blocked by an increase-risk flow and reachable from a CLI reduce-only path), G-BACKTEST-RUN-01 (:508, run identity, status, progress, failure and cancellation), G-BACKTEST-RESULT-01 (:509, the result page and its traceability), G-EXEC-01 (the pre-execution every real execution passes), G-EXIT-01 and G-CONTROL-01 (the protective exit and takeover controls the CLI intents serve) and G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01 (:506, the registered identity the run requests name). The plan-level statements the direction rests on were read as well: todo/README.md section 6 (:331-334, 'T073 delivers the pre-paper authorization entry ... before T071 or T072 operates paper' and 'T085 extends the same versioned write path rather than creating a second one') and the P07 phase README Entry (todo/phases/P07-risk-and-paper/README.md:7-14). The amendment adds no goal, threshold, authority or acceptance condition and weakens none.
impact_assessment.specification: No Spec edit and no spec_revision change: the config keeps v1-2026-09-20-strategy-successor-ownership. The clauses the contracts now cite exist and were read: WEB-GLOBAL-002 (docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md:28, evidence-first states), WEB-GLOBAL-003 (:34, write-operation grading, increases Web-only and reductions not blocked by the increase-risk flow), WEB-GLOBAL-006 (:58, the bounded pre-console entry point T073 owns, with the 'same semantics continue through its versioned write path, not a second mechanism' sentence at :66-67), WEB-PAGE-012 (:179, owned by T087 at :186-188) and WEB-PAGE-013 (:191, owned by T088 at :202, with its traceability-by-value requirement); CTRL-CLI-001 (docs/spec/operations/OPERATOR_CONTROL.md:187, read-only queries plus the reduce-only write set of reduce or remove LP, collect, exit, turning HOLD/LP/AUTO_SWAP off and lowering a USDG exposure limit, at :192-197). Nothing in the amendment contradicts, duplicates or rewrites a clause, and no new specification text is required to make the edited contracts executable.
impact_assessment.contracts: Exactly the eight named targets are edited, and no other contract, document or revision: T071.md (dependency T073, the G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 outcome paragraph, the paper-run gate deliverable, the refusal acceptance clause, the Must-not addition and the references), T072.md (dependency T073, the decision-resume prerequisite, the resume-gate deliverable, the acceptance clause, the Must-not addition and the references), T082.md (dependency T073, the authorized-window outcome paragraph, the window-record deliverable, the invalid-window acceptance clause, the Must-not addition and a References block replacing the frozen placeholder), T085.md (one added named section for the extended versioned write path and the CTRL-CLI-001 CLI boundary, the narrowed Must-not clause and the references), T086.md (dependencies T087 and T088, the journey and accessibility/security scope extension and the references), T091.md (the second intent class, the intake deliverable, two acceptance clauses, the Must-not addition and a References block replacing the frozen placeholder), T103.md (the results view named as WEB-PAGE-011's and explicitly not T088's page, the training/evaluation trigger deliverable, two acceptance clauses and the references) and T104.md (the second consumer and provenance deliverable, the acceptance clause, the Must-not addition and the references). Every original section is preserved and each contract still carries exactly one of the six required sections; each Dependencies line equals its configured list. The contracts that the new cross-references name from outside the target set - T069, T070, T073, T087, T088, T090 and T097 - are consistent with the statements made here and are not contradicted: T087 and T088 already own WEB-PAGE-012 and WEB-PAGE-013 and their read surfaces, T097 already writes through the same versioned records and refuses increases, T073 already says the later console extends the same write path, and T069 already owns the run identity and lifecycle the new obligations call. No contract is left asserting something a governing document no longer says, which is why affected_existing_tasks is empty; T088 in particular is not a target of this direction and its contract is neither edited nor contradicted.
impact_assessment.dependencies: Only four depends_on lists change, all sorted and duplicate-free, and each equals its contract's Dependencies line: T071 [T061, T070, T073], T072 [T033, T071, T073], T082 [T072, T073, T080, T081] and T086 [T083, T085, T087, T088]. Measured from the edited config, the closures become 45 (T071), 46 (T072), 49 (T082), 50 (T085), 56 (T086), 47 (T091), 57 (T103) and 22 (T104, unchanged), the whole graph stays acyclic under a DFS colour check, and each task that must reach a producer reaches it: T073 inside T071's, T072's, T082's, T085's (through T084 -> T072 -> T073) and T091's (through T072) closures; T087 and T088 inside T086's; and T069 inside T086's and T103's closures (through T102 -> T101 -> T069). No edge was added where the direction did not ask for one: T085's obligation to extend T073's path is enforceable through the measured transitive path, T091 cannot take a T097 edge (T091 -> T097 -> T091 is a cycle, measured), and T103's and T104's cross-references to T088 are references to another surface's owner rather than dependency edges - the same treatment T088 already gives T103. No dependency of any untargeted task changed, and no task was retired or re-pointed.
impact_assessment.implementation: No src/, tests/, tools/, .github/, docs/ or todo/schemas/ path is edited; the change set is the eight contracts and the four config leaves. The contracts are normative for work that has not been implemented yet: there is no web console, no CLI write surface and no research console in the tree, so these repairs state obligations rather than describe code. What exists and is deliberately untouched keeps its recorded disposition - for example the hard-coded five-name VALID_STRATEGY_KINDS validator in src/robinhood_lp/reports/manifest.py and the registry-bound successors T105-T108 that replace it, and the paper/ledger modules the P07 tasks will build. No second authoritative path is created or sanctioned: T085 keeps one versioned write path and one audit history, T091 keeps the Web write entry as the only increase path, and T104 states the provenance rule its own artifact already carries. Every repaired obligation is written as something the task's own tests can prove, so the Developer and the independent Reviewer verify it in code rather than by reading prose.
impact_assessment.data: No persisted artifact is read, written, migrated or created by this amendment, and no manifest, dataset, dataset version, ledger, lock, checksum, run record or review record is touched. The contracts add preservation and refusal rules instead: a paper run or a soak window may not start, and may not be counted as evidence, without the three T073 authorization records for the active pool and strategy version, and a window whose authorization was superseded or mismatched is reported as invalid evidence naming the affected interval rather than silently accepted; the results view T103 renders and the range and liquidity values T104 serves must declare the window, dataset version and reconstruction revision they came from, and a value whose provenance cannot be named is refused rather than displayed. Nothing is relabelled, backfilled or re-derived, and no historical record's authority is changed.
impact_assessment.operations: No running process, deployment, runtime configuration, attempt, evidence field or workflow state changes: all eight targets stay PLANNED at attempt 0, no task is activated, no implementation attempt is consumed and no approval or review record moves. Operationally the repaired contracts are fail-closed and the dependency edits make the phase-level prerequisites machine-checkable: T071, T072 and T082 now wait on T073 and therefore on the three Owner authorizations, and T086 now waits on the two console pages it validates. The register keeps 12 open A0013 impacts before this amendment; this amendment closes the eight on its targets, and the four it may not close stay open and named - A0013:T063:legacy, A0013:T064:legacy, A0013:T066:legacy and A0013:T067:legacy, all on APPROVED contracts that the retirement route (SUPERSEDE) must handle. Recorded consequence of the closure growth, not hidden: the closures of T071, T072, T082, T085 and T091 now also contain the approved predecessors T063, T064 and T066, whose impacts remain open, so the ready gate keeps those tasks blocked until the retirements land; that is the intended behaviour of an open impact; T104 is unaffected by that effect.
impact_assessment.security: No permission, trust boundary, credential or secret surface is added, and no secret, endpoint value, keystore or key material was read, printed or written during this amendment. The direction's security content is tightening only: paper may not run before the Owner's pool selection, HOLD/LP approvals and preliminary-paper authorization exist as immutable versioned records written through the Web entry point T073 delivers; every increase in a permission or an exposure stays Web-only with draft, impact preview, reauthentication and explicit confirmation, while a CLI reduction must not be blocked by an increase-risk flow and an increase requested from the CLI fails closed with no version, no action and a pointer to the Web entry; the CLI keeps no arbitrary-call path and no key, password or seed input; and no research artifact or result page gains execution, approval, paper or live authority. The risk gateway, pre-execution, signer boundary and promotion gates are named as unchanged constraints.
impact_assessment.verification: Read-only investigation in this worktree, never task-acceptance evidence and never a substitute for the independent amendment review. python -m tools.workflow validate returned status OK; python -m tools.check_acceptance check, python -m tools.check_citations check and python -m tools.check_imports check --suppressions docs/implement/ci/suppressions.toml --config todo/config.yaml --architecture docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md reported no findings; PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/test_workflow.py tests/test_workflow_contracts.py tests/test_documentation_links.py tests/test_documentation_citations.py tests/test_acceptance.py is 101 passed; the wider local suite (PYTHONPATH=src pytest --ignore=tests/test_abi_artifacts.py) is 2282 passed and 6 skipped, the ABI suite being an environment-dependent Foundry build that this planning change cannot affect; git diff --check is clean. The contract lint (tests/test_workflow_contracts.py:57-66) was replicated directly: every contract's title, exactly one of each required section, and a Dependencies line equal to the configured, sorted, duplicate-free list. Closure sizes, membership, the consumer sets and acyclicity were recomputed from the edited config, and the impact register plus the eight resolutions were recomputed through the workflow's own _unresolved_task_impacts, confirming the other four impacts stay open. The amended contracts' Acceptance clauses require the tests that prove each repaired obligation, including the refusal cases (absent, superseded or mismatched authorizations; refused CLI increases; cancelled or failed runs; values without declared provenance), so each task's Developer and independent Reviewer verify the repair in code.
